caption: Piazza dell'Anfiteatro, Lucca
composition: Oval square of pastel façades on the amphitheatre footprint · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands in the middle of the great oval of Piazza dell'Anfiteatro, ringed by the continuous sweep of pastel arcaded buildings that trace the Roman amphitheatre's footprint. Shuttered facades in peach, cream, and rose curve around left, center, and right, with warm lamps still burning beneath the ground-floor arches. The vast cobbled ellipse lies empty in the blue-hour light of the 07:08 morning, the sky a clear deepening blue above the rooftops.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Piazza dell'Anfiteatro in Lucca at twilight
